coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Nineteen attacks ran and none landed. Custody is intact: the subject held 40cda3c8 at mode 0444, HEAD remained the D-138 adoption 3c215ab, and all five measured inputs reproduce. The preference authority and successor mechanism both hold: D-132 expressly authorizes a D-036 successor after the three goal contracts, those candidates are recorded at D-136/D-137/D-138, and D-036 itself requires a successor to change its node set while limiting scheduling to drafting. D-139 obeys that boundary. The eight-row L list does not invent remainder: each entry resolves to an adopted source that keeps design work, a nonbinding candidate, or an express eligibility reservation open, and other rows are neither declared eligible nor admitted. D-002 is unchanged. Its 23-row SATISFIED-requiring set stands and all nine deferrals stand; W4's DR-128/129/130 shorthand is the D-010 tail, not removal of DR-106/108/109/110/113/116. Commands, TypeScript-only role, four platforms, independent-release, identities, and gates all remain intact. No row is marked SATISFIED or QUALIFIED, no Class A or D-096 grant opens, no file-08/COORD hygiene act is performed, and implementation remains unauthorized. Readiness stays zero-effect at 4 of 32 with condition 5 last. Reversibility is temporal for the H/L acts D-139 actually schedules and preserves the three candidate recordings.
